title: Arrive, Roppongi at night
anchor: The Louvre show at the National Art Center, open until 20:00 on Fridays.
notes: Land 14:45. The Skyliner reaches Keisei-Ueno in about 41 minutes; the hotel is a 10-minute walk.
17:00 Hibiya line from Naka-Okachimachi to Roppongi, no change, about 20 minutes.
Leonardo's La Belle Ferronnière is in Japan for the first time and the show closes 13 Dec. ¥2,200 in advance.
Book 西麻布 豚組 for dinner: it is a Friday.
Mori Art Museum fits after dinner only if it is open late that night. One listing says it shuts at 17:00 on 27 Nov.

title: Ginkgo, cats, sunset
anchor: 神宮外苑いちょう並木 at 07:30, before the Saturday crush.
notes: 07:05 Ginza line from Suehirocho (G14) to Gaienmae (G03), no change, about 20 minutes.
Ginkgo first, Gotokuji second: the avenue is shoulder to shoulder by 11:00, the cats will still be there at 09:30.
To Gotokuji: Ginza line to Shibuya, Den-en-toshi line to Sangenjaya, then the Setagaya tram to Miyanosaka. About 40 minutes.
Shibuya Sky tickets go on sale 14 days ahead, on 14 Nov. A 15:30–16:00 slot gets daylight, sunset around 16:30, and the lights.
Home: Ginza line from Shibuya (G01) to Suehirocho (G14), no change.

title: Todai ginkgo, then races or Kiyosumi
anchor: Japan Cup at 15:40 if the lottery comes through; MOT and Kiyosumi if not. Rikugien lit at night either way.
notes: Morning either way: Todai's ginkgo avenue to Yasuda Auditorium, quiet on a Sunday, then Kayaba Coffee 10 minutes' walk away.
Japan Cup: Shinjuku, then the Keio line to Fuchukeiba-seimonmae, about 35 minutes. In by 13:00 to see the paddock.
There is no gate sale on Japan Cup day. General admission lottery 22–24 Nov, result 25 Nov.
Clara's original afternoon: MOT's two shows, fukagawa-meshi (clams on rice) for lunch, Mameya Kakeru's coffee course, Kiyosumi Teien's stepping stones.
If the Japan Cup takes Sunday, MOT and Kiyosumi move to Thursday morning.
Rikugien: 18:00–20:30, last entry 19:30, ¥1,000 online or ¥1,200 cash. Then Tokiwa Shokudo, one stop away.

title: teamLab, then Yokohama
anchor: teamLab's first slot, then Yokohama's Christmas market at dusk.
notes: 08:00 Hibiya line from Naka-Okachimachi straight to Kamiyacho, about 20 minutes. teamLab is two minutes from exit 5.
Allow 1.5–2.5 hours. Check teamLab's calendar when booking: it closes some days without a fixed pattern.
13:00 Hibiya line to Naka-Meguro, then the Toyoko line straight through to Bashamichi, about 45 minutes.
Monday is the market's calmest day, and the cable car catches sunset around 16:30.
Home: JR from Sakuragicho to Okachimachi or Akihabara, about 50 minutes.

title: Kamakura and Enoshima
anchor: Hasedera's maples and Enoshima at sunset, on a weekday rather than a Sunday.
notes: 07:30 leave. JR to Tokyo, then the Yokosuka line to Kita-Kamakura, about an hour.
Kamakura's maples are among the last in Japan to turn, holding into early December.
Lunch: shirasu-don, whitebait on rice.
Enoden from Kamakura to Hase is five minutes; the Great Buddha is five minutes' walk from Hasedera.
If Hasedera announces its night illumination, flip the afternoon: Enoshima first, the lit maples at dusk.
Home: Odakyu from Katase-Enoshima to Shinjuku, about 70 minutes, or JR from Fujisawa to Tokyo.

title: Gyoen, Aoyama, and a night out
anchor: Shinjuku Gyoen in the morning, a tea counter or the Teien in the afternoon, racing or a hidden bar at night.
notes: Nezu Museum is closed between exhibitions from 24 Nov to 5 Dec, garden included. This day replaces it.
09:00 Marunouchi line from Awajicho straight to Shinjuku-gyoemmae. ¥500.
14:00, pick one: Sakurai's eight-seat tea counter (book), or Marimekko in the Teien's 1933 Art Deco house (timed, ¥1,400).
Evening A: Ōi night racing, ¥100, an SII race on the card, last race around 20:50, then Bar Trench. Pick this if the Japan Cup lottery fails.
Evening B: a top-100 sushi counter in Nakameguro, then Bar Benfiddich (TableCheck). Or Janai Coffee in Ebisu, or Gen Yamamoto.

title: Palace, Hibiya, Marunouchi, fly
anchor: Daitoku-ji at the National Museum, Marunouchi's lights at dusk, then Narita for the 22:00 flight.
notes: The Daitoku-ji show is in its last week: Muqi's Dragon and Tiger and a National Treasure Ido tea bowl. 15 minutes' walk from the hotel.
If the Japan Cup took Sunday, do MOT and Kiyosumi this morning instead.
11:00 check out and leave the bags at the hotel.
Imperial Palace East Gardens are free; walk the outer garden toward Hibiya.
Naka-dōri's 1.2 km of lit trees come on at 16:00. Tokyo to Akihabara is four minutes.
Leave the hotel by 18:45 for Narita: Skyliner from Keisei-Ueno, about 41 minutes, two hours before the flight.
